The antenna designed consists of a two-bit structure with a rotational symmetry of the upper and lower axes, and the loading of lumped capacitors enables the antenna bandwidth expansion of 39.5-45.8MHz (14.9% relative bandwidth). The horizontal omnidirectional gain difference of the antenna is about 1.5dB, and the maximum gain of the full band is greater than 2dBi.

articleTitle: Research on Text Matching Method Based on FAQ Knowledge Base
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: As an effective information retrieval method, Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) systems have been widely used in various online services. Studying FAQ text matching methods based on deep learning is of great significance for improving system performance and meeting user needs. This article proposes a FAQ text matching method based on the twin network learning model, and verifies its effectiveness through experiments. The long and short-term memory network structure algorithm is used, which can achieve an accuracy rate of more than 90%.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Rolling Bearings Based on SSAE and Domain Adversarial
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper proposes a domain adversarial neural network DASSM model based on Stacked Sparse Autoencoder (SSAE) and Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) for the complex mapping relationship between vibration signals and health conditions under fluctuating working conditions of rolling bearings. By utilizing the characteristics of unsupervised learning in SSAE, the optimal values of sparse parameters in the proposed model are analyzed to construct an effective feature extraction network structure. This can extract effective features from the vibration signal sample data of fluctuating working conditions, providing a foundation for the transition from stable working conditions to fluctuating working conditions. By using domain distance measurement and domain adversarial alignment simultaneously, the generalization ability of the model is improved, effectively reducing the difference in feature samples between the source and target domains. The experimental results show that the DASSM model can achieve the transition from stable working conditions to fluctuating working conditions, with a bearing fault diagnosis rate of over 97% and good robustness of the model.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Descriptor-Based DMA for 10 Gigabit Ethernet Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In response to the demand for enhanced data transmission performance in Ethernet interfaces, this paper adopts a design scheme for a DMA controller based on a descriptor structure. This design effectively reduces the workload of the CPU during data transmission, improves bus utilization, and accelerates the data transfer rate between the host memory and the network port.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Herbal Plant Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Herbal medicine is an important part of Chinese medicine, and the research on the recognition of herbal medicine can help to improve the recognition efficiency, reduce the labor cost, meet the recognition needs of non-specialists, and promote the inheritance and development of herbal medicine. The article designs a feature fusion focal pyramid network (PFN), which incorporates Channel and Spatial Attention Module (CSA), Feature Fusion Module (FFM) Attention Estimation Module (AE), and a new dataset of Chinese-Herbal-Medicine-Plants-50 (CHMP-50), which contains 63641 images of 50 classes, was built on the proposed dataset. a large number of experiments. The experimental results show that PFN achieves 96.91% accuracy for CHMP-50, 96.79% accuracy for TOP-1, 96.80% recall, and 96.80% F1 score, which is better than other typical deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Soil Moisture Prediction Model for Astragalus Plantation Based on Improved African Vulture Algorithm and Back Propagation Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Currently, there are few types of soil moisture prediction models in the outdoor field of Astragalus membranaceus planting environment, and the prediction accuracy is not high. Therefore, a BP neural network prediction model using the improved African Vulture Optimization Algorithm (IAVOA) to optimize model parameters is proposed. In order to solve the problem of low accuracy of the BP neural network prediction model and insufficient exploration mechanism of the African Vulture Algorithm leading to inaccurate prediction data, the exploration stage of the Eagle Algorithm (AO) is first integrated into the exploration stage of AVOA, and the Circle chaotic map is introduced to increase population diversity when initializing the population. Afterwards, the improved IAVOA-BP algorithm will be used to optimize the weights and thresholds of the BP algorithm, resulting in a soil moisture prediction model for Astragalus membranaceus cultivation based on the improved IAVOA-BP algorithm. Finally, environmental data such as light intensity, wind speed, etc. collected will be used as input, and soil moisture changes will be used as predicted values. The results show that compared with the BP prediction model, the improved IAVOA-BP model reduces the average absolute error percentage by 77.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, the average absolute error by 81.8% the root mean square error value by 78.4%, and the mean square error by 95.1%. The improved BP prediction model can accurately predict the changes in soil moisture during the cultivation of Astragalus membranaceus.

articleTitle: Radio Frequency Fingerprints Identification by Convolutional Neural Network with Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Radio frequency fingerprints identification (RFFI) is a critical technology for ensuring network security by authenticating devices by extracting and comparing the intrinsic different characteristics presented as unintentional modulations on pulse (UMOP) or radio frequency fingerprints. Traditional RFFI techniques are mostly generated from expert experience, utilizing expert-designed features to identify different signals. Recently, deep learning models like convolutional neural network (CNN) have been widely studied for RFFI feature extraction and classification. However, the performance of deep learning methods is often limited by the availability of extensive and diverse training data. To address this challenge, we introduce a data augmentation enhanced CNN method, thereby enriching the training dataset and improving the feature generalization capabilities of CNN. The proposed method is tested on a signal source dataset; the experimental results demonstrated that the identification performance is improved with this proposed method.

articleTitle: A Dual-stage Adaptive Federated Model Aggregation Method for Heterogeneous Data
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: To address the problem of performance degradation of federated learning on heterogeneous data, this paper proposes a dual-stage adaptive federated model aggregation method for heterogeneous data, DAFMA. Initially, the server utilizes a hypernetwork to assign weights hierarchically to local models, dynamically aggregating client model parameters to construct a global model. Upon receiving the global model, clients adopt an adaptive aggregation mechanism, which not only leverages the enhancements of the global model but also preserves the unique knowledge characteristics of local data, thus avoiding the simplistic overwriting of local models. Extensive experiments conducted on the EMNIST, and Cifar10 datasets have demonstrated the efficacy of the DAFMA algorithm in enhancing the performance of federated learning on heterogeneous data.

articleTitle: Ontology Knowledge Based Multimodal Service Tasking Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Considering smart device and robot having entered the home environment to provide human with convenient services, this paper proposes a multimodal service system to enhance the system dynamic understanding of the environment and dynamic task planning capabilities. The proposed system introduces a family ontology to record information about the object, device, and user. The multimodal information can be acquired and updated automatically to the family ontology. The task planning and execution are introduced to dynamically generate task. Finally, the experiments in a family environment prove that the system has outstanding task processing capabilities and environmental understanding.

articleTitle: An Improved Chan-Taylor Hybrid Location Algorithm Based on UWB
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of mobile Internet, there has been an increasing demand for indoor positioning technology. Among the existing indoor positioning technologies, ultra-wideband signal technology-based positioning has garnered significant attention. Particularly, the fusion positioning approach combining Chan algorithm and Taylor algorithm is considered a relatively mature technique. However, in environments with non-line-of-sight errors indoors, the Chan algorithm exhibits poor accuracy and real-time performance. This paper proposes a message queue-based residual selection location algorithm to address this issue. Firstly, the credibility of each base station is calculated and sorted to assign weights accordingly. The base stations are then queued successively while always keeping three base stations in the queue until all base stations have been queued and subsequently removed after completion of positioning process. Finally, the obtained results are weighted and summed based on their respective weight values to derive the final result. Experimental results demonstrate that this algorithm further enhances both accuracy and real-time performance compared to the Chan-Taylor algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Processing of Integrated Signal for Co-Frequency Detection and Jamming Based on Timing Constraint
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper proposes an integrated signal of co-frequency detection and jamming based on timing constraint, so that the self-defense system can further realize target detection on the basis of jamming. First, intermittent sampling and forwarding with high real-time performance and high isolation is used to generate dense false targets to jamming the enemy radar. Secondly, in order to achieve target detection, detection signal is emitted at intervals of intermittent sampling and forwarding to detect moving targets. Finally, in order to further improve integration, the detection signal and the jamming signal use the same frequency band and share a set of RF systems to reduce costs. The simulation results show that the integrated signal can not only achieve dense false target jamming, but also complete the detection and pulse accumulation of close-range high-speed moving targets, and also has the function of resolving Doppler ambiguity.

articleTitle: PSA-CsiNet: A CSI Feedback Algorithm for Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Focusing on the demand for efficient and fast feedback of channel state information (CSI) in massive multiple input multiple output (MIMO) communication systems under frequency division duplex (FDD), this paper proposes a CSI feedback algorithm, polarized self-attention CsiNet (PSA-CsiNet), based on polarized self-attention mechanism and multi-resolution mechanism to address the problems of high complexity and weak accuracy of existing deep learning (DL) algorithms. The polarized self-attention mechanism weights the attention in the orthogonal dimension of the feature map, which enhances the feature extraction ability of the neural network. Moreover, the multi-resolution mechanism adopts convolution kernels of different scales, which realizes the multi-scale feature extraction of the feature map. Simulation results show that the algorithm outperforms compressive sensing-based algorithms under COST2100 channel. Meanwhile, comparing the DL-based algorithms, the algorithm achieves significant performance advantages in indoor environments with the compression rates of 1/4 and 1/16.

articleTitle: Study of Multi-Excitation Source Wireless Energy Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The application of multi-excitation source and multi-load wireless energy transmission technology can improve the efficiency of charging new energy devices and give more freedom of power regulation to wireless energy transmission technology. In the paper, the influence of power supply frequency, voltage and mutual inductance on the wireless transmission efficiency and output power is analysed by constructing a three-excitation source and three-load wireless energy transmission circuit model and applying the principle of coupled circuit. The design of single-phase bridge inverter using unipolar SPWM control is proposed, and for the impact of load variation on the output, an adaptive PID control method is proposed to achieve constant current output to the load. Using MATLAB simulation, a physical experimental platform is built to verify the effectiveness of the design scheme.

articleTitle: Exploring Audience Attitudes Toward AI Influencers by Textual Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The rise of social media has facilitated the growth of social media influencers as effective advertising channels, bridging communication gaps. Concurrently, artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed traditional marketing with the emergence of AI influencers-virtual personas supported by AI technology. This study focuses on AI influencers in China, analyzing 12,690 comments from Weibo about prominent figures like AYAYI, Angie, and Ling between April 2023 and April 2024. Using Python web scraping and textual analysis, sentiment analysis, thematic clustering, and content coding techniques were applied to explore audience attitudes and opinions. The study aims to illuminate the role and perceptions of AI influencers in social media marketing, addressing associated risks and promoting their development.

articleTitle: Research on Resume Classification System Based on Graph Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate an innovative resume classification method that utilizes heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNN) to construct resumes, jobs, and job categories into a heterogeneous graph, aiming to improve the accuracy and efficiency of resume classification. In this system, the resume is regarded as the target node, and a heterogeneous graph network is constructed by connecting with the nodes of related jobs and job categories. Using graph neural network model for feature aggregation and classification, the model can effectively capture the complex relationship between nodes, so as to achieve accurate classification of resumes. The experimental results show that the proposed method is significantly superior to the traditional methods in classification performance, and provides a new idea and technical support for the design of resume classification system.

articleTitle: Research on Vulnerability Detection Techniques Based on Static Analysis and Program Slice
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Binary program vulnerabilities are particularly difficult to detect and understand using traditional methods due to their concealment and complexity. To address this challenge, we propose an innovative binary code vulnerability detection frame- work that combines program slicing techniques with a hybrid neural network model to achieve high-precision identification and classification of vulnerabilities in binary code. Specifically, we first generate semantically relevant binary slices using Program Dependence Graphs (PDG). These slices are then processed by a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BLSTM) and an attention mechanism to extract deep semantic features, while a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is employed to extract sequential features of the slices. Additionally, we introduce a Siamese network to evaluate the similarity between different code fragments, enhancing the model's ability to recognize unknown vulnerability patterns. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach performs exceptionally well in binary program vulnerability detection, significantly improving both the accuracy and efficiency of the detection process.

articleTitle: Predefined Time Neurodynamic Approach to Mixed Variational Inequality Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to address the mixed variational inequalities, this study proposes a proximal neurodynamic technique with predefined-time stability. Our approach incorporates adjustable parameters, differentiating it from traditional fixed-time stability methods and increasing its versatility and applicability. Unlike fixed - time and finite-time stability techniques, the proposed method demonstrates the ability to reach a unique solution within a predetermined time limit. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed approach are verified through simulations, confirming the theoretical derivations.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation for Hierarchical Federated Learning in Edge Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Numerous internet of things(IoT) devices generate massive amounts of data, and transmitting the data to cloud servers for model training incurs significant communication overhead and training delays. Federated learning protects user privacy and reduces communication overheads through a unique approach to model training. Furthermore, the diversity of IoT devices results in data and resource heterogeneity, severely impeding the efficiency of federated learning training. To address these issues, this article proposes a device selection strategy within a hierarchical federated learning framework. This strategy improves training efficiency by comprehensively considering device data along with computational and communication resources. Simulation experiments demonstrate that our proposed framework and algorithm achieve higher learning accuracy and faster execution times compared to existing solutions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Output-Feedback Control for Switched Nonlinear Systems with Input Dead-Zone and Saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper examines the advancement of an adaptive fuzzy control system designed for handling switched systems subject to fluctuating input dead-zones and actuator saturation effects. It introduces a state observer and fuzzy logic systems (FLSs) to manage the system's uncertain states and complexities. The research considers the problem of input dead-zone points shifting over time in practical engineering. In addition, a second-order adaptive regulator is established for the controller to solve unknown parameter problems caused by input dead-zone and actuator saturation. Leveraging average dwell time (ADT) techniques and backstepping strategies, the system's tracking error is reduced to near zero. Finally, a simulation case is included to affirm the proposed control strategy's performance.

articleTitle: Robustness of Memristor-Based Design of Accurate Binary Differential Convolutional Neural Network for Biomedical Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel edge computing system named memristor-based accurate binary differential convolutional neural network (MABDNet) for biomedical image classification. The system utilizes precise binary differential algorithms to approximate full-precision weights, thereby maintaining accuracy while enhancing robustness, rendering it more suitable for hardware implementation. Experimental results demonstrate that when the yield rate of memristor arrays is greater than or equal to 50%, MABDNet achieves a classification accuracy of 85.15% on the MedMNIST v2 dataset, whereas traditional binary neural networks (BNNs) only attain 51.99%. Furthermore, it is observed that with an increase in noise intensity, the classification accuracy of MABDNet also improves, indicating that moderate introduction of Gaussian noise can enhance the robustness of MABDNet to a certain extent.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Phase Unwrapping of GB-InSAR
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Ground Based Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (GB-InSAR) is used in deformation measurement and geological disaster early warning detection due to its high resolution and wide measuring range. Phase unwrapping, as a key technology in radar data processing, generally has low accuracy in areas with poor coherence. The paper proposes an improved phase unwrapping method. First, it calculates the coherence coefficient of PS points, dividing them into low coherence areas and high coherence areas. Points in low coherence areas are unwrapped using the minimum norm method, while points in high coherence areas are unwrapped using the traditional method, namely the minimum cost flow method. The results of combining both methods are integrated with the results of multi-baseline phase unwrapping to obtain more accurate unwrapping phase. By comparing the data obtained from a three-dimensional laser scanner, the standard deviation of the error for this method is reduced by about 20% compared to traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Radiation Antenna Array with Frequency Diverse and Digital Encoding for Phase Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Stochastic radiation source is the core of microwave staring correlated imaging (MSCI) which serves to generate stochastic radiation fields (SRFs). Existing stochastic radiation sources are controlled in a single mode and have a limited number of SRFs. This letter proposes a stochastic radiation antenna array with frequency diverse and digital encoding for phase control (SRAFD). It operates in the X-band and has the ability to modulate the SRF in both frequency and phase dimensions, significantly enlarging the number of SRFs. SRAFD consists of patch antenna elements of different structures to achieve frequency diverse for generating SRFs. An FPGA independently control the switching of two PIN diodes equipped with each antenna element to achieve a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$180^{\circ}$</tex> radiation phase difference. We fabricated a prototype of an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 8$</tex> antenna array, and the measurement results of S11 and radiation pattern closely matched the simulation data. Moreover, The SRFADs are utilized to build an imaging system, imaging of the target scenes consisting of angular reflectors is obtain by the sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) algorithm.

articleTitle: Distribution Networks Wireless and PLC Integrated Communication Coverage Optimization Technology Based on Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Wireless and (power line carrier) PLC integrated communication system can effectively provide service transmission reliability in distribution scenarios and meet the demand of differentiated power services. In this paper, a wireless and PLC integrated coverage optimization technique based on improved Sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is proposed for distribution scenarios. Firstly, PLC-wireless nodes will be arranged according to the PLC topology to provide the possibility of dual-mode communication transmission for power services. Secondly, the wireless nodes are utilized to complement the blindness so as to maximize the coverage. And the improved SSA algorithm based on Tent mapping is proposed to solve the above coverage maximization problem. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the coverage of wireless and PLC integrated communication network.

articleTitle: SAR Image Aircraft Target Detection Based on Multi-Auxiliary Head Supervision Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of target detection in DETR network and alleviate the problems of long training period and slow convergence, a Multi-Auxiliary Supervised DETR (MS-DETR) network was designed for aircraft target detection in SAR images. In this paper, a multi-head supervisory module is designed to process the data output from the encoder, in which multiple supervisory auxiliary heads extract potential features and input them to the decoder to improve the shortcomings of the one-to-one label allocation method in the DETR network. A matching enhancement module is also designed to add to the decoder to alleviate the matching discreteness brought by the Hungarian matching algorithm and improve the loss convergence speed. The experimental results show that compared with the original method, the accuracy of AP0.5 and AP0.75 is improved by 7.9% and 7.4%, and the training period of the proposed method based on the same training network is reduced by 3.3 times. The method presented in this paper effectively improves the accuracy of SAR image target detection and effectively reduces the training period of DETR network.

articleTitle: Characterization of the Trap Evolution of GaN High-Electron-Mobility Transistors Under Off-State Stress
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Under the effect of high electric field, the gallium nitride based microwave power device due to the interface defects and trapping effect will intensify material damage. This is an important factor affecting the degradation of the device's electrical parameters in high-power and high-frequency applications. In this paper, by applying different stresses to the device, the trap evolution law under the electrical pulse stress is analyzed, and the influence of pulse frequency on the device trap evolution and the device degradation mechanism is clear. Under off-state pulse stress, the device degradation increases with the stress pulse frequency due to inverse piezoelectric effects and gate electron injection.

articleTitle: Radar Signal Modulation Recognition based on Multi-scale Self-correlation Combined with Layered Convolution-GRU Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to satisfy the modulation recognition requirements for radar signal with agility pulse-width, bandwidth and modulation type, the multi-scale self-correlation combined with layered convolution-GRU network is proposed in this paper. First, the waveform is processed by multi-scale self-correlation with different accumulation points to obtain the time-amplitude and time-frequency information; Second, the local characteristics were extracted by layered convolution network respectively; Lastly, the local characteristics of each self-correlation are integrated, and the GRU network is adopted to extract the serialization representation. The proposed network combines the advantages of local characteristics of CNN and the sequence characteristics of GRU. The simulation shows that the modulation recognition accuracy is more than 95.4% over the detection sensitivity for normal, LFM, NLFM, FSK, BPSK, QPSK signals.

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Fault-Tolerant Control for Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems with Sensor and Actuator Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper researches the fault-tolerant control (FTC) of nonlinear multi-agent systems (MASs) under sensor and actuator faults at a fixed-time. This paper studies consistency tracking problem in multi-agent in depth. Firstly, the functions of unknown nonlinear is approximated by fuzzy logic systems (FLSs) and fault compensation signals are introduced in this process to reduce the effect of sensor fault. In this process, by command filter technology to solve the problem of “Singularity” and “Computational explosion”. Then, the situation of actuator and control direction uncertainty are solved by using Nussbaum function. Finally, the stability of system is proven. Last part, simulating control strategy and illustrating effectiveness.

articleTitle: Input-to-State Stability of Saturated Impulsive Systems with External Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper discusses saturated impulsive control for nonlinear systems with external disturbance. In the discussion, the conditions under which the system achieves input-to-state stability(ISS) under the interference with external disturbances and saturated control at impulse moments are thoroughly examined using the Lyapunov method. Meanwhile, by using the polyhedral model of the saturation function, we express the system as a convex combination and, combined with Lyapunov stability theory and linear matrix inequalities, addressed the saturation function at impulse moments. Simulations are provided to verify the proposed conclusions under the control of the saturation function.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Statistical Test and Cross-Check Method for Detecting Block Withholding Attack of Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Most of cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin and Ethereum are produced by mining pools, and Block Withholding attack (BWH) takes the mining pools as the target. As far as we know, the detection of the BWH attack is still an open problem. In this work, we propose a new method-Hybrid Statistical Test and Cross-Check (HSTCC) for detecting BWH attack. In the statistical test phase, we introduce the Poisson distribution cumulative probability test function to judge the expected income and actual income of the miners, so as to find out the suspicious miners with possible BWH attacks. In the cross-checking phase, inspired by the honeypot idea, we distributed a template that could quickly find the full proof of work to the miner to cross-check whether the miner was an attacker. The experimental results on the dataset of real bitcoin mining pool Eligius show that compared with the traditional statistical test method of 7.7% precision, the proposed HSTCC method can accurately find the miners who implement BWH attack; compared with the cross-check method that all samples need to be verified, the HSTCC method reduces the check samples by 77.6%.

articleTitle: A Near-Field Measurement Method for Detecting the Rotation Direction of a High-Power Microwave Helical Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: High-power microwave (HPM) helical array antennas have attracted extensive attention in the research of HPM antennas because they can achieve directional transmission of a large amount of microwave energy by changing the current phase. The angle of the HPM helical antenna is controlled by the rotation of the array unit. Therefore, in this paper, a method of rotation angle of a single HPM helical antenna with a dipole is studied by simulation. In the case of a fixed dipole antenna, the voltage amplitude and phase information received by the rotating helical antenna are compared at different angles. This paper also verified the convergence of the evaluation results at different angular intervals. The results show that it is feasible to use a dipole to detect the rotation angle of a HPM helical antenna element.

articleTitle: Research on Metamaterials of Large Hangars to Solve the Problem of Multipath Interference on Localizer
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The Localizer provides horizontal guidance information for aircraft approaching and landing, which directly determines the safety of the “last kilometer” of civil aviation flight. In recent years, the Localizer has been restricted and degraded more and more frequently due to the multipath interference from large buildings. The Localizer is usually located in the extension of runway centre line, and the distance from the end of the runway is from 180 m to 600 m, which means that once the signal of the Localizer is interfered by the multipath interference from the large buildings, it is difficult to eliminate of the effects through the relocation of the station site. A metamaterial perfect absorber (MPA) is demonstrated at 108.5 MHz in this article, simulated and measured results of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{S}_{11}$</tex> at 108.5 MHz are approximate −50 dB and −26 dB respectively, the corresponding absorption rates are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$99.999 \%$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$99.75 \%$</tex>. Thus, when metamaterials are used on the exterior facade of the large buildings which cause multipath interference, reflection of incident electromagnetic waves can be minimized to the greatest extent possible, and it can safeguard the safety of civil aviation flights.

articleTitle: A 20-Gb/s Low Power Inductorless TIA Design in 0.18µm CMOS
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The performance demands on transimpedance amplifiers (TIA) for optoelectronic conversion have increased with the rapid development of fiber optic communication technology. A modified feedforward common gate (MFCG) transimpedance amplifier with an inductor less topology is suggested for analogue front-end wireless fiber optic communications applications. This leads to a significant improvement in the circuit power consumption and band-width. An improved auxiliary amplifier without Miller effect is used instead of the traditional FCG common source amplifier to improve the bandwidth and reduce the phase jitter. An improved parallel active inductor is used instead of the traditional active inductor to obtain a more favorable bandwidth compensation effect. Small-signal analysis demonstrated that the M-FCG has a low input impedance, a large output impedance and transconductance con-version ratio. Based on a 0.18-µm CMOS process post-simulation results, the M-FCG circuit exhibits a transimpedance gain of 58.87 dBΩ, a bandwidth of 6.33 GHz, an equivalent input current noise of 27.02 pA/-VHz, a power consumption of 1.9 mW in the core circuit, and occupies a layout area of 0.0054 mm2. Additionally, the eye diagrams were generated using PRBS at a rate of 20 Gb/s. The resulting eye diagram displays openness and clarity, thereby meeting the requirement for 20 Gb/s code element transmission.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Energy Stored Quasi-Z-Source Inverter Multi-Scenario Parameter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Photovoltaic energy stored quasi-Z-source inverter (PV -ES-QZSI) can achieve high performance coordinated control of energy storage and photovoltaic, but its power quality and cost issues can limit its wide application to some extent. In this paper, ripple and cost are selected as the optimization objectives to optimize the system parameters. However, in actual optimization, the daily PV power curve is complex and changeable with the weather. If the involved PV multiple scenarios are ignored and the parameter optimization is carried out in a single PV scenario, the results will not be comprehensive and representative. In view of this problem, this paper considers the complex working conditions of the photovoltaic scene, conducts the clustering analysis of the intra-day photovoltaic power curve of one year, establishes the cluster center with the typical photovoltaic curve and the weight of days, and constructs the multi-objective optimization function with the goal of cost and ripple. Compared with the optimization results obtained from the model analysis in a single photovoltaic scenario, the research in this paper can improve the comprehensiveness of the parameter efficiency optimization. Finally, the superiority of the proposed method is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fixed-Time Containment Control for Switched Systems Under Average Dwell Time
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper investigates adaptive containment for a class of nonlinear switched systems with unmeasurable states, leveraging fixed-time stability theory and the average dwell time method. A novel observer is introduced to estimate the unmeasurable states and to mitigate the impact of unknown disturbances. The containment controller designed in this study ensures that the settling time remains bounded regardless of the system's initial state and provides flexibility in the switching signal. Furthermore, all signals of the closed-loop system exhibit fixed-time stability, and the containment error converges to a certain region of the origin within finite time. Finally, a simulation is conducted to verify the efficacy of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Bipartite Synchronization of Random Delayed Complex Dynamic Network with Signed via Self-Triggered Quantized Impulsive Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, the leaderless and leader-following synchronization problem for a class of signed complex dynamic networks with random delay and external disturbances is studied. Firstly, considering the influence of random delays in the system, a self-triggered strategy based on the system method is given, which can exclude Zeno behavior while ensuring the stability of the system. Secondly, in order to improve control efficiency, this paper combines quantized control with self-triggered impulsive control, and designs a novel self-triggered quantized impulsive controller. Finally, considering the characteristics of signed networks, this paper ensures the bipartite synchronization of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband Digital Variable Gain Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The DVGA is based on 0.18μm SiGe BiCMOS process and integrated modules such as Mode Switch, Gain Control, Output Stage, Input & Output Interface and so on. In order to meet the requirements of broadband communication, the DVGA uses folded cascode as active negative feedback to pull down the node impedance and achieve a bandwidth of 1.26GHz. The circuit has a gain range of 61dB, OP1dB of 18dBm, NF of 6dB and CMRR of 88dB. It is suitable for high-speed broadband RF front-ends.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Synchronization Control of Delayed RDNNs via Semi Loop Functional
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Under the framework of spatially averaged Measurements (SAMs), this study investigates the synchronization problem of delayed reaction-diffusion neural networks (RDNNs) via an event-triggered control strategy (ETS). Firstly, a method utilizing semi-looped functional techniques is introduced. By optimizing the constraints of the initial control algorithm, the probability of finding solutions is enhanced, thereby accelerating the exploration of control parameters. To conserve limited transmission channel resources, an event-triggered control scheme is introduced. Secondly, we derive the synchronization criteria under SAMs using Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) and inequality techniques. Subsequently, the Event-Triggered Sampling controller is obtained by solving linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Quadrotor Attitude Control Under Active Disturbance Rejection Control Method Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: For solving parameter uncertainties and external interference sensitivity of quadrotor aircraft, quadrotor attitude control under an active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) scheme based on improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed. Compared with cascade PID control method, ADRC strategy adopts the concept of adaptive disturbance rejection control, it means that the disturbance model is integrated into the system model, and can directly evaluate and compensate the disturbance. Simulation results show that the auto-disturbance rejection controller designed in this paper can not only estimate and compensate the internal and external interferences, but also has strong robustness to the parameters of uncertain quadrotor aircraft.

articleTitle: Detection of Peanut Rhizobia Based on Improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Peanut rhizobia play a very important role in nitrogen fixation in peanut. In this paper, a peanut rhizobia counting network based on improved YOLOv7 is proposed. Considering the small size and dense distribution of peanut rhizobia, the detection head of YOLOv7 is adjusted by removing the 20×20 detection head and changing the 40×40 and 80×80 sizes to 80×80 and 160×160 to better cope with the detection of small targets. To improve the network's attention to the main part of the image, we introduced the simple attention module before feature fusion. For the comprehensive nature of peanut rhizobia detection, this paper proposes a chunked training strategy and improves distance intersection over union to effectively eliminate redundant frames. The experimental results show that compared with the original YOLOv7 network, our model mAP is improved by 2.6%. The combined experimental results show that the model exhibits significant performance improvement on the peanut rhizobia detection task.

articleTitle: Orthogonality Analysis for Finite Game Space via Semi-Tensor Product
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, two decomposition forms of finite game space are studied by using semi-tensor product as a basic tool. The concepts of finite game space and some kinds of special game space are given according to the number of players, the set of strategies and payoff function characteristics. Based on this, the algebraic verification equations and bases of different game subspaces are obtained by converting the payoff function into algebraic form. Meanwhile, numerical examples are given in order to better explain the relevant conclusions.

articleTitle: A Dual-Loop Charge Pump Phase-Locked Loop Based on 130nm CMOS Process with Output Frequency Range of 0.5GHz~2GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to realize the requirements of high-speed communication processor chips for clock signals with wide bandwidth and low jitter, a charge pump phase-locked loop with an input reference clock frequency range of 62.5MHz,…, 125MHz and an output clock frequency range of 0.5GHz,…,2GHz is designed using a 130nm CMOS process. This paper describes the operating principle of the dual-loop charge pump and the architecture of the designed dual-loop charge pump, describes the circuit structure of the frequency discriminator, the dual-loop charge pump, the voltage-controlled oscillator and the programmable frequency divider, and verifies the overall circuit with system simulation. The phase-locked loop circuit designed in this paper uses a dual-ring charge pump structure to optimize the structure of the low-pass filter. At 1.2V operating voltage, the output clock peak-to-peak jitter is less than 778fs at an input reference clock frequency of 125MHz and an output frequency of 2GHz, with a total power consumption of 3.57mW. The output clock peak-to-peak jitter is less than 5.21ps at an input reference clock frequency of 62.5MHz and an output frequency of 0.5GHz, with a total power consumption of 1.158mW.

articleTitle: Research on Network Card Virtualization Technology Based on SR-IOV
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: To address the high overhead and low efficiency issues of software-simulated 1/0 virtualization, this paper designs a hardware architecture for a network card virtualization module based on SR-IOV technology and extends the VF driver at the software layer for data packet reception. The virtualization module determines the RX queue of the data frame based on its MAC address and VLAN tag information. In the VF driver, a polling thread pool and thread scheduling module are added to fully utilize the multi-core CPU resources. Experimental results show that this combination achieves high data transmission performance, allowing a single port to provide dedicated data reception paths for multiple virtual machines.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies for Multifunction Air Defence Radars
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: To cope with increasingly sophisticated threats, multifunction air defence radars are developed to carry out simultaneous air and missile defence, and to provide target indication and even missile guidance for air defense fire units. The paper addresses key technologies for multifunction air defence radars, including fully digital AESA, integrated multichannel TR module, adaptive radar resource management, target recognition and multi-domain ECCM, and presents some emerging technologies for multifunction air defence radars, including ultrawide band RF, distributed collaborative detection, quantum radar and intelligent radar.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Nested Parallel High Compatibility 5G Polar Encoder
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Polar codes which can reach the Shannon capacity limit, have been a research hotspot in the field of information technology in recent time. The international telecommunication organization has determined that 5G communication will adopt Polar codes as an important channel coding scheme. This paper proposes a High Resource Efficiency Nested Parallel High Compatibility (HRENPHC) 5G Polar Encoder. It achieves nested parallel processing by gradually decomposing the Polar coding process. Compared to the full parallel Polar encoder, it reduces the hardware complexity by about 30 times and improves the utilization of circuit resources. The encoder architecture is fully compatible with the encoding requirements of various code length granularity of Polar codes. This work is implemented on the FPGA platform, and the experimental results show that it has multidimensional advantages in terms of circuit efficiency, implementation complexity, compatibility, and performance compared to related advanced research.

articleTitle: A Distributed Multi-Channel Narrowband ANC System with Frequency Mismatch Correction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The centralized multi-channel narrowband ANC (CMNANC) system employed for noise reduction in a wide region is computationally complex. Moreover, the presence of frequency mismatches in the reference signal severely compromises noise reduction performance, potentially leading to system breakdown. To overcome these drawbacks, this paper proposes a distributed multi-channel narrowband ANC system with frequency mismatch correction (DMNANC-FMC), which introduces a frequency offset compensation algorithm based on the momentum least mean square technique. Additionally, its computational complexity is further simplified by exploiting the relative independence of individual nodes. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed system effectively mitigates noise, even with up to a 20% frequency mismatch, while simultaneously reducing computational burden.1

articleTitle: Flexible, Breathable and Sweatproof Piezoelectric Sensors Based on Additive Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Flexible piezoelectric sensors have widespread applications in the field of wearable devices and human-machine interaction technologies. However, the manufacturing of these sensors mostly relies on manual assembly, lacking efficient manufacturing processes. In this paper, the “one-step” fabrication of flexible piezoelectric sensors is achieved with a self-developed multi-component additive manufacturing composite system The sensor was designed with the electrospun PVDF functional layer, printed Ag electrode layer, and electrospun TPU encapsulation layer. The produced sensors exhibit a sensitivity of 0.04 V/N, a rapid response time of 25 ms, good breathability <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(600\ \mathrm{g}/\mathrm{m}^{2}/\text{day})$</tex>, and excellent sweat resistance. This method offers a promising approach for the efficient manufacturing of breathable and sweatproof flexible piezoelectric sensors.

articleTitle: A Frequency-Selective Surface Operating in Ka and W Bands for Arbitrary Polarizations
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, a frequency selective surface (FSS) of dual frequency reflector antenna for arbitrarily polarized waves is designed and fabricated. The FSS is formed by the periodic structure with a ring patch as a unit. Within the range of incident angles of electromagnetic waves from 0° to 30°, the simulated and measured results show that the FSS reflects W band electromagnetic wave and enables the Ka band transmit, the FSS acts as a sub-reflector of a dual-reflector antenna for the W band and the Ka band works with a single reflector antenna. The S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> in scattering matrix containing amplitude and phase of electromagnetic waves of horizontal and vertical polarization is used to analyze the FSS. The results indicate that the FSS is not only suitable for linear polarization but also for circular polarization. The design process of FSS and the simulated and measured results are presented and compared with others. The basic agreement between them proves the correctness of the design and analysis.

articleTitle: Method for Wheat Ear Detection Based on CSR-DETR
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Precise detection of wheat ears is essential for agricultural yield assessment and breeding research. Current object detection technologies still face issues with insufficient accuracy and low detection efficiency when dealing with small targets like wheat ears. To address these issues, this study proposes an improved RT-DETR: CSR-DETR. CSR-DETR integrates CBAM and ScConv into the main network to enhance feature extraction capabilities, and then replaces the Conv module in CCFM with RFCAConv to further improve feature fusion effects. Finally, CSR-DETR is compared with RT-DETR on two wheat ear datasets of varying sizes. The results show that the improved model achieved an mAP of 83.2 % on a dataset of 2690 wheat ear images, an increase of 1.4 percentage points from the original model; and an mAP of 92.4% on a dataset of 6500 wheat ear images, an increase of 1.2 percentage points from the original model.

articleTitle: A Fast Obstacle Detection Method Using a Dual 3D LiDAR
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Obstacle detection plays a crucial role in unmanned vehicle path planning, demanding heavy computational resources for accurate detection, often challenging real-time requirements. In this study, we introduce a dual LiDAR approach for obstacle detection and propose a drivable space detection algorithm based on multi-spatial feature fusion for sampling and segmentation. Our method enhances the accuracy and efficiency of obstacle point cloud segmentation compared to other ground-based point cloud segmentation algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Intrusion Detection Methods of Automotive Networks Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the popularization of intelligent connected cars, the number of interactions between the vehicle's interior and the external network has increased, and the difficulty of malicious attacks on the car's internal network has also been greatly reduced. In order to effectively detect these malicious attacks, an intrusion detection system (IDS) is required. Unlike IDS, there are few known attack signatures for vehicle networks. In addition, IDS for vehicles requires high accuracy because any false positive error can seriously affect driver safety. In order to solve this problem, an IDS based on the deep learning Model-Generative Adversarial Nets is proposed. Experimental results show that this model has high accuracy in detecting malicious attacks and can effectively detect intrusions.

articleTitle: Research of Low Probability of Intercept Ultra-Wideband Radio Fuze
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Low probability of intercept (LPI) technology enhances the radio fuze's performance in resisting interception, sorting, and identification, as well as improve its survivability in complex electromagnetic environments. This paper, building on ultra-wideband (UWB) radio fuze technology, outlines the approaches to achieving low interceptability for UWB radio fuze systems and verifies their feasibility through simulation calculations, providing a theoretical reference for the design of radio fuze.

articleTitle: A COVID-19 Recognition Algorithm Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Since the end of 2019, the Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) has spread rapidly around the world and the novel coronavirus pneumonia has become an infectious disease that poses a threat to global health. Rapid and accurate diagnosis can not only prevent the spread of diseases, but also better allocate limited medical resources. Unfortunately, due to the specificity of medical imaging, it's challenging to acquire a large-scale dataset for COVID-19. To tackle this challenge, we collected and organized a 15k COVID-19 image dataset and proposed a multi-feature network fusion model based on transfer learning. This model enhances the feature extraction ability of convolutional neural networks by analyzing their characteristics, and uses transfer learning knowledge to obtain the optimal features. Then, it uses serial fusion to fuse different optimal features. Compared with classical models, our model enhances the feature extraction ability of the network and solves the classification problem of medical images in small-scale situations. The recognition accuracy on the target dataset reaches 98.77<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>.

articleTitle: An Emotion Recognition Scheme Based on EEG Signal and Visual Information
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Comprehensive analysis of EEG signals and visual information provides a more precise method for identifying human emotional states. Utilizing discrete wavelet transform technology, key features in EEG signals can be effectively extracted, while feature category selection is conducted based on the visual content viewed by the tester. By combining the EEG signal features with the visual information features, a more comprehensive feature set is formed. Compared to traditional methods that rely solely on EEG signals for emotional recognition, the strategy of fusing EEG signals with visual information exhibits higher recognition accuracy. Experimental analysis results on the DEAP dataset and MAHNOB-HCI dataset show that, in terms of valence dimension, this scheme achieved the highest average recognition accuracy of 0.8573; in terms of arousal dimension, it achieved the highest average recognition accuracy of 0.7183, significantly outperforming the recognition performance using only EEG signals.

articleTitle: Distributed Data-Driven Iterative Learning Control for Consensus Tracking of MASs against Deception Attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In the paper, we study the problem of distributed model-free adaptive iterative learning control (DMFAILC) for multiagent systems (MAS) under deception attacks. Firstly, we introduce an improved dynamic linearization technology in iteration domain to establish an equivalent data model of MASs. Then, an attacks compensation strategy is developed to mitigate the impact of deception attacks. Subsequently, a DMFAILC scheme is developed based on input and output of the system model. Moreover, the convergence of the consensus tracking error is proved using the contraction mapping method. Finally, a simulation result is provided to verify the effectiveness of the developed DMFAILC scheme.

Author Keywords: distributed model-free adaptive iterative learning control (DMFAILC)

articleTitle: Infrared and Visible Image Fusion Method Based on Multi-Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The edge and texture preserving ability of fusion algorithm will be affected under the interference of noise and artifacts. To solve this problem, an infrared and visible image fusion method based on multi-feature is proposed. Firstly, iterative guided filter with scale-aware and edge-preserving properties is applied to decompose the source images into base layer and a series of detail layers. The iteration process can not only better separate the spatially overlapping image feature information, but also effectively reduce noise and suppress edge artifacts. Then, in order to retain more important details of the source image, binary weight maps are synthetically determined by edge, sharpness and contrast features, which are optimized by guided filtering to reduce noise and suppress artifacts. Finally, the fusion image is obtained by linear combination of the decomposition information. Experiments show that proposed method is superior to other methods in suppressing artifacts and noise.

articleTitle: A UAV Routing Protocol Based on Short-Time Trajectory Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Due to the highly dynamic and mobile nature of UAVs in FANET, communication links are variable and fragile, posing significant challenges for data transmission. Existing routing protocols rarely integrate the speed attributes and positional information of UAV nodes effectively. This paper investigates a UAV routing protocol based on short-time trajectory prediction (TPR) for FANET. The proposed TPR protocol improves the routing selection process and enhances network performance by considering UAV position changes and future destination information. We conducted simulations using OMNET++ and compared the performance of TPR with AODV, DSDV, and GPSR. The results show that under the Random Waypoint (RWP) mobility model, TPR's packet delivery ratio (PDR) is improved by 42.6862% compared to AODV, 18.826% compared to GPSR, and 16.3298% compared to DSDV. Under the Gauss-Markov (GM) mobility model, TPR's PDR is improved by 46.9914% compared to AODV, 26.7908% compared to GPSR, and 29.3696% compared to DSDV. TPR also significantly enhances throughput, with improvements of 44.4603%, 6.7977%, and 5.3355% under the RWP model compared to AODV, GPSR, and DSDV, respectively. Under the GM model, the throughput improvements are 41.8338%, 3.3204%, and 28.33%, respectively.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Load Frequency Control for Multi-Regional Power Systems Under Power Market
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the development of the power system, the competition under the power market is becoming increasingly fierce. The supply and demand transaction between regions becomes more and more frequent. The influence of power market on load frequency control can't be ignored. In order to overcome the interference caused by inter-regional power exchange for power system. An improved model-free adaptive load frequency control method is proposed in this paper for multi-area power systems with unknown models. Firstly, to model bilateral contracts under free markets, the generation participation matrix is introduced. The dynamic evolution relationship of the system with the generation participation matrix is established. The data relationship model of the system is obtained using dynamic linearization techniques and a frequency tuning control algorithm is designed. Finally, the proposed algorithm's effectiveness is simulated and verified with a three-regional power system.

articleTitle: Low Power White Balance Based on Channel Segmentation for Flexible AMOLED
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Camera is an important part of portable electronics such as smartphone and smartwatch, and most of these products use flexible AMOLED as display panel. Since display power occupies most power consumption of these products, a low power white balance method based on channel segmentation for flexible AMOLED is proposed in this paper. The display power is reduced by processing Y channel, while white balance is realized by histogram shifting of Cb and Cr channels. The reduction of power consumption and the realization of white balance are processed in separate channels. Therefore, color distortion and abnormal brightness variation are avoided. The experimental results show that the histogram overlap area of the proposed method is comparable to the current technique, while the display power and brightness variation are reduced by at least 5.67% and 54.73 %, respectively. Finally, an image display system is built, and images processed by the proposed method are displayed on the flexible AMOLED panel.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Efficient Clustering Routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Collaborative Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: To address the rapid energy depletion and short network lifespan in traditional clustering protocols for wireless sensor network (WSN), specifically the Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH), this paper introduces a collaborative LEACH protocol (C-LEACH). The proposed protocol refines the cluster head election threshold by incorporating the nodes' residual energy, neighbor count, and distance to the base station, optimizing the probability of a node being selected as a cluster head. Secondly, nodes compute the cost function by considering the cluster head's energy, the number of neighboring nodes, and the distance to them, ensuring an optimal and scientific selection of the cluster head. Finally, regarding the transmission method, the cluster head communicates with the base station through collaboration among individual cluster heads based on their distance from the base station, reducing the energy consumption of the cluster head. The results show that the C-LEACH protocol extending the network life cycle by 144.3% and 97.4% compared to LEACH and ILEACH, respectively, thereby reducing energy consumption and extending the network's operational time.

articleTitle: Research on the Characteristics of Radio Wave Propagation in the Diverse Terrains: Analysis and Application Based on the ITV-R P. 1546 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper presents an in-depth analysis of radio wave propagation characteristics in various typical terrains of China using the ITU-R P.1546 model. The study reveals that lowering the transmission frequency and increasing the antenna height can effectively expand the coverage range of the antenna. Case studies of radio wave propagation characteristics in mountainous, hilly, and coastal terrains are conducted, demonstrating the significant impact of terrain on radio wave propagation. It is concluded that when designing wireless communication systems, factors such as terrain and propagation media must be comprehensively considered to enhance system performance and coverage range.

articleTitle: Interference Range-Doppler Image Detection by Stacking Classifier Design for Over-the-Horizon Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: Over-the-horizon radar can be seriously affected by radio frequency (RF) interference and transient interference. It is essential to detect and suppress the interference to ensure good performance of the radar. Interference can be visualized on the range-Doppler (RD) images. In this paper, we propose a novel approach based on machine learning and stacking model. We introduce a sophisticated stacking model for the identification and classification of RD images. This model enables effective interference recognition and classification. We employ two feature extraction techniques: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) and Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG). Three machine learning algorithms are employed as base-learners: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest, and LightGBM (LGB), where LGB functions as the meta learner. Simulation results show that the stacking model achieves higher accuracy for interference recognition compared to any individual learner. It achieves an accuracy of 97.5% for the strong interference images.

articleTitle: Stochastic Optimal Power Flow in Transmission Grid With Renewable Energy Based on Steady-State Security Region
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: To deal with the significant influence of the uncertainty of renewable energy generation output on the power flow of the transmission grid, this paper constructs a stochastic optimal power flow model based on the steady-state security region (SSR). First, based on the AC power flow model and the sensitivity method, the hyperplane expressions of SSR are derived. Second, a chance-constrained optimal power flow model is established combined with the Cornish-Fisher series. Third, a heuristic algorithm is proposed to solve the established model. A modified IEEE 39-node transmission grid is applied for simulation. The results show that the proposed method can quickly deal with uncertain power injections with secure constraints.

articleTitle: Output Feedback Control Under Constraint Conditions for Flapping-Wing Robot Aircraft System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In this paper, the output feedback control problem of Flapping-Wing Robotic Aircraft (FWRA) system with boundary constraints is studied. Through the output feedback control, we realize the precise control of the FWRA system, which provides a guarantee for its stable flight in practical applications. Firstly, high-gain observers are designed to estimate the unknown states of the system, through accurate state estimation, we could better grasp the dynamic characteristics of the system. Secondly, a logarithmic barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) is used to constrain the boundary of the FWRA within its range, so as to ensure that the FWRA would not exceed its safety boundary during flight. Then, the output feedback controllers are designed according to the designed BLF, which can effectively suppress the vibration of bending and torsion deformation of the system. Finally, all signals of the system are proved to be bounded by rigorous mathematical analysis. The simulation results further verify that the proposed control method can ensure the stability of the system when the parameters are reasonably selected.

articleTitle: ISAR Image 3D Reconstruction Based on Improved KLT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper presents a method utilizing inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging for target matching and three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction. First, the Harris algorithm is employed to extract feature point from the image. Then, an improved algorithm based on Kanade-Lucas- Tomasi (KL T) is introduced for tracking and matching these feature points. The method conducts affine matrix, incorporating hierarchical iteration and bidirectional matching of two consecutive frames to enhance the number of matching point set, improve tracking accuracy, and establish feature points association across sequential images. Finally, the factorization method is applied to achieve the 3D reconstruction of the target. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of this 3D reconstruction approach.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Fault Diagnosis for CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The Controller Area Network (CAN) bus, as a widely adopted communication protocol in real-time control systems, has played a crucial role in automotive electronic control systems, industrial automation systems, and even medical devices, owing to its outstanding real-time performance, high reliability, and excellent multi-node data exchange capabilities. However, in the event of a fault occurring in any node on the CAN bus, all interconnected devices on the bus may potentially be affected. Therefore, effective fault diagnosis for the CAN bus is of significant importance. Addressing this challenge, this paper proposes a technical solution that combines One-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (1DCNN) and Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM). The proposed 1DCNN-LSTM model achieves precise fault diagnosis by real-time monitoring of voltage changes in the CAN bus. Experimental results have demonstrated the effectiveness of this approach, showing a higher fault diagnosis accuracy compared to traditional methods relying solely on 1DCNN.

articleTitle: MIMO-SAR High Precision Deformation Monitoring System with 3D Imaging Capability
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The ground-based synthetic aperture radar (GBSAR) is an all-day, all-weather, accurate and reliable deformation monitoring method. This thesis examines a set of principles and methods for millimeter-wave radar micro-deformation monitoring with 3D imaging capability, utilizing multiple inputs multiple outputs (MIMO) radar and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) technology. The experimental prototype radar employs a MIMO antenna array and emits linear frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) electromagnetic waves, enabling a maximum monitoring distance of approximately 200m. It is equipped with a two-dimensional precision slide rail, enabling high angular resolution in both azimuth and elevation. Experimental results demonstrate that the deformation monitoring system can achieve high-precision 3D imaging of targets and sub-millimeter deformation monitoring accuracy.

articleTitle: Two Trajectory Decoy Strategies for UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: The traditional trajectory decoy strategy has not considered enough the flight path planning and traj ectory tracking ability of VA V. In order to lure the VA V flying along the predetermined route to the designated acquisition area under the trajectory tracking algorithm, two trajectory decoy strategies, multiple trajectory pulling and directional trajectory pulling, are proposed according to the trajectory decoy model. The VA V trajectory decoy model is constructed by carrot trajectory tracking model, two trajectory decoy strategies are designed, and the two trajectory decoy strategies are compared by theoretical analysis. The simulation results show that although the two trajectory decoy strategies can achieve the fixed point acquisition of VA V, the directional traj ectory pulling strategy has a better effect on the deception concealment of VA V.

articleTitle: A Method for Transmitting Real Human Skeletal Points to the Virtual Reality Character
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the development of electronic information technology and virtual reality technology, there are numerous technologies and products related to virtual reality. Among them, real-time transmission of human body movements in reality to characters in virtual reality is one of the popular research directions. Most of the technologies transmit the 3D coordinates of the VR headset and handle worn by the user to the virtual reality, however, this transmission method can only transmit the data of the skeletal points (head, hands, feet, etc.) which have already been stipulated, and it can't reflect the user's limb movements more realistically. In order to solve this problem, this paper first obtains the user's body and hand skeletal points, the number of these skeletal points is much larger than that of the traditional method, and the spatio-temporal information of the skeletal points that need to be transmitted in real time is relatively large because the skeletal points of the human body are changing at every moment, the method of this paper is to re-encode the 3D data coordinates of the obtained skeletal points, and transmit the encoded data points in layers to the virtual reality. The experimental results show that our method can improve the success rate of human skeletal point transmission, and can achieve real-time transmission of the user's limb movements to the character roles in virtual reality.

articleTitle: Intensive Electromagnetic Target Association based on Multi-dimensional Characteristics Fuzzy Weighted Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: In order to improve the intensive electromagnetic target association requirement for electronic reconnaissance, the multi-dimensional characteristics fuzzy weighted algorithm is proposed in this paper. On the basis of the signal deinterleaving, each dimensional electromagnetic parameter is carried out by nonlinear Euclid distance as the degree of membership firstly, and then the membership degree of different electromagnetic parameters is fuzzy weighted, finally the electromagnetic target is tracked based on the weighted membership. The simulation demonstrates that the proposed algorithm can track the intensive target with interlocking electromagnetic parameters accurately, and it has good robustness to the parameters of algorithm.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Vehicle OTA Software Update System: Design and Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: With the widespread popularity of intelligent connected vehicles, the demand for software updates of Electronic Control Units (ECUs) is becoming increasingly frequent. However, as the functionality of software update packages becomes more enriched, the time required for Over-The-Air (OTA) update also lengthens accordingly, and the security of update packages particularly important in this process. Aiming at the problems existing in the current OTA update of vehicle, this paper proposes an OTA system solution based on Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) hybrid encryption and decryption technology and Ethernet transmission. Through validation, this OTA system not only significantly reduces the time for OTA updates but also ensures the security of update packages, thereby meeting the growing update demands and security standards.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Switched Observers for Networked Distributed Multi-Agent Systems via Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Electronic Engineering and Informatics (EEI)
abstract: This paper designs event-triggered switched observers for the networked distributed multi-agent systems based on the cloud computing systems. Firstly, a novel cloud computing system architecture is designed, in which each group of agents can interact with each others through distributed cloud nodes, and each cloud node also serves as an event-triggered switched observer to observe the topologies of the systems. Secondly, event-triggered switched observers are designed, which can assist distributed agents in accurately obtaining information from the leader, even with continuous switching topologies. Then, through stability analysis, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the observers. Finally, we prove the feasibility of the observers through simulation.
